promises.promise: Why was rupa's roll number struck eleven months before the list was read, and on whose instruction?
promises.listener_wants: the date and the hand behind the pencil line
promises.paid_how: Page four of the receipt book: hariya's thumb on the ninth of the eighth month, the strike on the eleventh. The instruction is found to be nobody's, and kishore says so on the ground in ep14.

promises.promise: kishore humiliated rupa in front of two hundred candidates and did not remember her face in ep11.
promises.listener_wants: kishore forced to acknowledge her in front of that same ground
promises.paid_how: He sets aside the strike and names her over the loudspeaker to the same ground, in the same month, one year on.

promises.promise: The engagement sweets came back with the string still tied.
promises.listener_wants: the box to come back the other way
promises.paid_how: The same box returns with the boy's family's string on it; munni refuses it and files her own examination form instead.

promises.promise: hariya has mortgaged the house to lakhan for ninety thousand at five per cent monthly.
promises.listener_wants: the house paper out of lakhan's tin box
promises.paid_how: rupa counts out the full principal from six months of her own commission; lakhan dismounts, discharges the debt and reads the receipt aloud at the gate.

promises.promise: nagesh says he is 'the man standing near the man from March' and that the difference will matter later.
promises.listener_wants: the difference explained
promises.paid_how: He states the man from March does not exist, that there are nine of him, and that one of them is in the room.

promises.promise: The girl in Sonbarsa who came second in the written and would take the shirt.
promises.listener_wants: to know whether she was real
promises.paid_how: nagesh admits he invented her in a tea shop in eleven seconds; there was only ever one shirt.

promises.promise: ratan says his rate is five hundred a day and the narrator tells the listener to remember it.
promises.listener_wants: confirmation that the men in badges are daily wagers
promises.paid_how: nagesh confirms it and notes rupa was the only person who ever heard ratan say a true thing.

promises.promise: The office stamp spells the district BARHAGRAH.
promises.listener_wants: to know whether it is an error or a design
promises.paid_how: nagesh explains that a perfect seal is forgery and a misspelt one is a private office with a spelling problem — a difference of nine years. Closed finally in ep14 by a stamp that spells it correctly.

promises.promise: dularchand's sixth notice, typed since Tuesday, on the seed godown compound where hariya has lived nineteen years without a lease.
promises.listener_wants: that notice destroyed
promises.paid_how: dularchand reads the address aloud and tears it up on rupa's table with the staircase listening.

promises.promise: sarita's son phulchand, fourteen years and two months, missing after twenty-two went and twenty-one returned.
promises.listener_wants: the boy found
promises.paid_how: rupa finds him at the second kiln on the Jhajha road and brings him back on the four o'clock bus.

promises.promise: The twenty-two names and bansi's advance book — what happens to a case this good.
promises.listener_wants: bansi charged
promises.paid_how: nagesh reveals in ep12 that he sold the file to bansi's brother for nineteen thousand; the charge itself lands in ep14 as twenty-two counts registered at the real station.

promises.promise: 'The pile on the left' — whether anything from the first floor was ever forwarded anywhere.
promises.listener_wants: to know where four hundred files actually went
promises.paid_how: nagesh states plainly that there has never been a forwarding of anything from that office to anybody in eight months.

promises.promise: The clause on the back of lakhan's receipt allows the whole principal to be called on the fifth of any month.
promises.listener_wants: to see the fifth arrive
promises.paid_how: lakhan calls the principal at the gate at six in the morning and names the fifth of the following month.

promises.promise: Was kajri ever confirmed? pushpa refuses to answer.
promises.listener_wants: the answer
promises.paid_how: Page two of the receipt book: kajri's fifty-five thousand, thumbed, against a post that never existed. Nobody in that office was ever confirmed because there was nothing to confirm.

promises.promise: Somebody told nagesh what rupa said behind a shut storeroom door.
promises.listener_wants: the informer named and made to pay
promises.paid_how: kajri is shown in ep8 buying her position with rupa's sentence; the receipt book naming her fifty-five thousand goes to kishore in ep14 and she is named on the ground.

promises.promise: nagesh says he never touched rupa's ninety thousand and tells her to remember that he said it first.
promises.listener_wants: to find out where the money went
promises.paid_how: Page four: it was hariya's thumb, seven weeks before the notice existed. nagesh took the promise in August and the money in March, and by his own definition never touched it in the way rupa assumed.

promises.promise: Four hundred and nine households whose matters exist only in rupa's handwriting.
promises.listener_wants: those files to survive the office
promises.paid_how: kishore rules that the receiving column makes every one of them provable and takes all four hundred and nine into the real station's register.

promises.promise: rupa signed three hundred and one files knowing the office was not real.
promises.listener_wants: her to answer for it rather than be excused
promises.paid_how: She writes her own statement, has kishore watch her sign it, and is placed under enquiry — stated aloud to the ground rather than buried.

promises.promise: kishore orders rupa to bring the kachhwara file to him personally at seven in the morning.
promises.listener_wants: that meeting
promises.paid_how: She arrives at the gate at seven with four registers, the advance book, the receipt book and her own confession.

promises.promise: kishore asks which batch rupa is from.
promises.listener_wants: her to be able to answer it truthfully
promises.paid_how: The strike on roll one-nine-six is set aside on the ground and her marks are read out: sixty-eight out of eighty, three minutes twelve.

promises.promise: phulchand arrested on a complaint of stealing four thousand rupees for an axle worth eleven hundred.
promises.listener_wants: the boy out and the complaint destroyed
promises.paid_how: The complaint is withdrawn on the morning of the fifth and twenty-two counts are registered against the contractor instead.

promises.promise: sarita asks whose handwriting is on every page of her son's file.
promises.listener_wants: rupa to answer her
promises.paid_how: rupa answers it in writing, in her own statement, and kishore reads the substance of it to the ground with sarita standing in the crowd.

promises.promise: pushpa is promised two rooms and a window at kachhwara with her name spelled correctly.
promises.listener_wants: her to get it
promises.paid_how: Confirmed in ep14: she is at the real station signing her statement and opening the kachhwara window the following month.

promises.promise: The lorry to Patna on the sixth and the room nagesh has kept for three years that nobody has seen.
promises.listener_wants: him stopped before the lorry
promises.paid_how: He is taken on the fifth, on the recruitment ground, one day before the lorry.

promises.promise: dularchand's eighty-one notices and the four canal-side farmers.
promises.listener_wants: the fields back
promises.paid_how: All four canal-side matters withdrawn aloud in front of the staircase and fifty-five thousand rupees counted out for three crops.
